locksmith_relevant: Combs Ford's riverside Victorian and Edwardian terraces often retain original sash windows and period locks requiring specialist knowledge.
Stowupland's post-war semis and modern builds typically feature standard cylinder locks but increasing demand for upgraded security systems.
Market town location means high proportion of older commercial properties in town centre with heritage lock systems needing careful handling.
